column1: # Uzbek, Latin script (uz, uz-Latn-UZ) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   source     exact English lookup key (tl!(...), ribbon and command labels)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\ inside a column. Keep all `{name}` placeholders and trailing ….
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. Missing entries show in English.
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary
# Uzbek computing vocabulary. No Microsoft Word (or other product) localisation, string table or
# translated UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Product, format and technology names (Doc4Me, PDF, Markdown, MCP …) stay in Latin letters.
# Orthography: oʻ and gʻ are written with U+02BB (ʻ), the tutuq belgisi with U+02BC (ʼ), never
# with an ASCII apostrophe. Commands use the verbal noun (Saqlash, Qoʻyish), labels sentence case.
# After a number the noun stays singular (3 ta soʻz). Language names use -cha (Inglizcha).
# Machine translation by an AI model (Claude), not yet reviewed by a native speaker.
